premarket.market_expectations: Neutral bias prevails with mixed global cues as US futures dip slightly while Indian institutional flows remain positive. The rupee weakens against the dollar and crude prices retreat sharply, but domestic cash levels from FIIs/DIIs provide support. With volatility cooling significantly and indices holding near range highs, the setup favors cautious optimism pending earnings catalysts.
